criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 28 February 2027 (12 months after the 28 February 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the long-stop date as 1 July 2026 (150 days after signing on 1 February 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 15 July 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($625,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (28 February 2027), with days remaining from 6 February 2026 (387 days).
Notes that 28 February 2027 is a Sunday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 1 March 2027.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
